title: Finally releasing on Steam
author: ShoogarSoft
selftext:
Started this project when EA declared NFS dead and now NFSU2 is back on the browser with the recent reverse engineering craze.

I mean it's great and all that and I played again to re-live my childhood, but the timing for this has been off and I decided to release it to move on to the next project.

Claude is great with ThreeJS and I feel I can add any feature I want in the game. If you guys find this promising, let me know what you want to see or fixed and we'll definitely get it done  for my Early Access promises.

comments.author: candyhunterz
comments.body: this is the definition of slop
